name: Telegram Bot API C2 Command & Exfiltration Tunnel
description: Detects outbound web flows communicating with Telegram Bot API endpoints (api.telegram.org) from non-official client apps, a primary technique used by ToxicPanda, Hook, and CraxsRAT for exfiltrating SMS OTPs and receiving bot commands.
remediation: Block api.telegram.org for untrusted applications in Firewall Access Control.
